## Learning Objectives

By the end of this week you should be able to:

1. Distinguish supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning, and give an example of each.
2. Define a model, its parameters, and the role of a loss function.
3. Describe the train/test workflow and explain what inference means.
4. Work through 1D linear regression end to end as the simplest supervised model.
5. Discuss the ethical considerations raised by deployed deep learning systems.
